title: symphyotrichum novi-belgii
intro: Symphyotrichum novi-belgii, commonly known as New York aster, is a flowering plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is rich in health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to help soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Symphyotrichum novi-belgii include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
